758:t_1:406.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm sorry, Chief. There are still some things I'd like to review. Could you give me one more day?」

758:t_1:408.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I understand. I promise to submit flawless data.」

758:t_1:409.en:
$$トビー$$
「Once that's approved, the $$バルゴラ$$ will finally enter official mass production.」

758:t_1:410.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Don't decide we're finished already, $$トビー$$. Our mission is far from over.」

758:t_1:411.en:
$$トビー$$
「I know. The road of $$ＧＳコンバット・アクション$$ is long, hard, and endless.」

758:t_1:412.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「That's right. ...You and I decided to stay here and keep $$グローリー・スター$$ going with $$セツコ$$ instead of returning to our own world.」

758:t_1:413.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Don't forget that resolve, $$トビー・ワトソン$$.」

758:t_1:414.en:
$$トビー$$
「Understood, Chief. I've made up my mind, and I won't do things halfway. I swear it on the name of $$グローリー・スター$$.」

758:t_1:416.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「And let me tell you, our combat-technique research won't be some genteel affair at a base somewhere.」

758:t_1:418.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「It looks like our new assignment will be gate defense.」

758:t_1:419.en:
$$トビー$$
「So we'll guard the hyperdimensional world... the passage between parallel worlds...!」

758:t_1:421.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「That's the spirit! Get fired up, $$グローリー・スター$$!」

758:t_1:423.en:
$$セツコ$$
(In this hyperdimensional world, the gates connect parallel worlds... I'm sure I'll be able to see everyone in $c again...)

758:t_1:424.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I'll live in this new world, with the pride of $$グローリー・スター$$ in my heart, as someone with the right disposition...)

758:t_1:428.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I see. You're going back to school, $$カミーユ$$...」

758:t_1:430.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What are you planning to study?」

758:t_1:431.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'm going to study engineering so I can develop mobile suits.」

758:t_1:432.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I see... Maybe someday I'll pilot a machine you designed.」

758:t_1:433.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You're staying in the military, Captain $$アムロ$$?」

758:t_1:434.en:
$$アムロ$$
「From here on, humanity will move forward on its own feet. My job of protecting that first step is over.」

758:t_1:435.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So I'll leave the front lines and become a test pilot, putting my own interests first.」

758:t_1:436.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then I'd like you to test the machines I build, Captain $$アムロ$$.」

758:t_1:437.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I intend to build machines suited to the coming age of deep-space exploration.」

758:t_1:438.en:
$$アムロ$$
「All right. I'll look forward to seeing them completed.」

758:t_1:439.en:
$$エマ$$
「Are you going back to school too, $$ファ$$ and $$フォウ$$?」

758:t_1:440.en:
$$ファ$$
「Yes... I'm going to study to become a nurse.」

758:t_1:441.en:
$$フォウ$$
「I guess I'll study so I can find out what I want to be and what I want to do.」

758:t_1:442.en:
$$エマ$$
「So $$カツ$$ is the only one joining the military.」

758:t_1:443.en:
$$カツ$$
「In my case, that's only if Dad gives me permission.」

758:t_1:444.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ブライト$$ and I will put in a word with $$ハヤト$$ for you.」

758:t_1:445.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$カツ$$ wants to join, but what if I get sent to the officers' academy along with him...?」

758:t_1:446.en:
$$クェス$$
「Does Captain $$ブライト$$ want you to join the military, $$ハサウェイ$$?」

758:t_1:447.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I don't know. We've never talked about it.」

758:t_1:448.en:
$$クェス$$
「Then you should talk to him properly. He's your father, after all.」

758:t_1:449.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「You're right. I'll tell him clearly that I want to study botany.」

758:t_1:450.en:
$$リディ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$... $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s political broadcast is about to begin.」

758:t_1:451.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I see... Let's watch it here, then.」

758:t_1:452.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...I am $$ハマーン・カーン$$, representative of $$ネオ・ジオン$$. I will explain to everyone watching the direction $$ネオ・ジオン$$ aims to take as a political party.」

758:t_1:453.en:
$$カツ$$
「That surprised me. I thought Colonel $$シャア$$ would be $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s representative.」

758:t_1:454.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Apparently, the Colonel will assist $$ハマーン$$. He says that if he takes the lead, they'll never break free of the old $$ジオン$$...」

758:t_1:455.en:
$$クェス$$
「$$ギュネイ$$ says he's going to be his bodyguard. Whatever he says, he really does like the Colonel.」

758:t_1:456.en:
$$リディ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$... $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s political broadcast is about to begin.」

758:t_1:457.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I see... Let's watch it here, then.」

758:t_1:458.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...I am $$ハマーン・カーン$$, representative of $$ネオ・ジオン$$. I will explain to everyone watching the direction $$ネオ・ジオン$$ aims to take as a political party.」

758:t_1:459.en:
$$カツ$$
「That surprised me. I thought Colonel $$シャア$$ would be $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s representative.」

758:t_1:460.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Apparently, the Colonel will assist $$ハマーン$$. He says that if he takes the lead, they'll never break free of the old $$ジオン$$...」

758:t_1:461.en:
$$オットー$$
「I suppose things have fallen into place...」

758:t_1:462.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Indeed. $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has completely disarmed and become a political organization backed by the colonies.」

758:t_1:463.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「I'm not so sure... I believe they still have military forces in reserve...」

758:t_1:464.en:
$$リディ$$
「Then we simply need to work toward a society where they won't have to use them.」

758:t_1:465.en:
$$オットー$$
「You've learned to speak your mind, Ensign $$リディ$$.」

758:t_1:466.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$クロノ$$ no longer exists. We can decide the future of the world and our own futures according to our own will.」

758:t_1:467.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「That's a good attitude. I'll whip you into shape all over again, so brace yourself.」

758:t_1:470.en:
$$ブライト$$
「It seems you're concerned about $$シャア$$.」

758:t_1:472.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If the times call for him, I'm sure he'll take center stage again.」

758:t_1:474.en:
$$アムロ$$
「He won't live in a way that disgraces what he gained in $c.」

758:t_1:475.en:
$$チェーン$$
「He's already settled things with you, Captain. I don't think he'll do anything reckless now.」

758:t_1:476.en:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「That's right. $$アムロ$$ has something else he needs to settle.」

758:t_1:477.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll take my time with that.」

758:t_1:478.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I don't think you can afford to, Captain.」

758:t_1:479.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Maybe not... Maybe I should follow $$バナージ$$'s example and make my own wishes clear.」

758:t_1:480.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(Good luck, $$バナージ$$. We're all rooting for you both.)

758:t_1:484.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...I am $$ハマーン・カーン$$, representative of $$ネオ・ジオン$$. I will explain to everyone watching the direction $$ネオ・ジオン$$ aims to take as a political party.」

758:t_1:485.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「It feels strange... To think we were fighting alongside her just the other day.」

758:t_1:486.en:
$$ミコット$$
「You could say the same about everyone in $c.」

758:t_1:487.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「You're right. ...But that's all in the past now.」

758:t_1:488.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「First, I'll graduate from school. I need to do that before I think about what comes next.」

758:t_1:489.en:
$$ミコット$$
「Let's all do our best, $$バナージ$$, you too.」

758:t_1:491.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Thank you, $$オードリー$$... It was only for a little while, but I'm glad I got to see you.」
